blocks.heading: Featured Tour Packages
blocks.intro: Handcrafted packages combining verified safari permits, luxury resort stays, meals, and private transfers across Ranthambore.

blocks.heading: Day-by-Day Wildlife Itinerary
blocks.intro: How a typical 3-day / 2-night tiger tracking package is experienced.

items.label: Day 1
items.title: Arrival in Sawai Madhopur & Evening Safari
bullets: Check-in at pre-selected jungle resort with welcome refreshments.
Pre-safari naturalist briefing on tiger tracking and zone terrain.
Afternoon Jeep / Canter Safari across designated core or buffer zone.
Evening return, Rajasthani cultural folk dance & bonfire dinner.

items.label: Day 2
items.title: Dawn Tiger Safari & UNESCO Ranthambore Fort
bullets: Early morning dawn safari when tigers stalk around waterholes.
Sumptuous breakfast buffet at resort followed by leisure time.
Guided historical trek to the 10th-century Ranthambore Fort & Trinetra Ganesh temple.
Late afternoon tea and optional secondary twilight safari drive.

items.label: Day 3
items.title: Chambal Crocodile Boating & Departure
bullets: Scenic morning excursion to National Chambal Sanctuary (Pali Ghat).
Motorboat river safari spotting Marsh Crocodiles, Gharials & Skimmers.
Return to resort for checkout and luggage transfer.
Private cab drop at Sawai Madhopur Railway Station or Jaipur Airport.

blocks.heading: Package Inclusions vs Exclusions
blocks.intro: No hidden surprises. Everything is clearly outlined before you confirm your tour.

groups.title: What is Included
items: Confirmed Jeep / Canter Safari permits with all government gate fees
Registered Forest Department naturalist guide for every safari drive
Luxury jungle resort stay on twin/double sharing basis
All buffet meals (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner as per plan)
Pick-up and drop from resort to safari gate in registered Gypsy
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and swimming pool access at resort

groups.title: What is Excluded
items: Airfare, train tickets, or intercity transportation to Sawai Madhopur
Any camera lens fee charged directly at the forest entry gate
Personal expenses like laundry, alcoholic beverages, and tips
Early check-in or late check-out charges not specified in the voucher
Travel insurance and medical emergency expenses

blocks.heading: Handpicked Jungle Resorts & Tented Camps
blocks.intro: Choose the accommodation style that matches your comfort and safari budget.

bullets: Handcrafted royal tents with bathtub
